description: Lists sport and competition keys (such as soccer or soccer_english_premier_league) for the sport filter of odds, raw_odds, history and events. Serves every region, one region code a call. Costs no tokens. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous reply, with the same other arguments

limit.description: Most sports to return; a note counts the rest

region.description: One region code from the regions tool, such as uk or us. Left out, the API uses uk, or refuses with region_required and names the code to send.

name: sports
title: Sports
